sections.title: Mechanical Engineering Design Laboratory
sections.description: This is the first of a two-semester junior level laboratory sequence that students complete over the fall and spring semesters. The course is project-based, with problems whose solution requires experimental data and quantitative analysis, as well as creative mechanical design. The technical content is connected to MEAM 3020, MEAM 3200, and MEAM 3540, including aerodynamics, applied fluid systems, and structural analysis. The course also includes electromechanical systems and applications of finite element analysis. Prerequisite: Junior standing in engineering
